prompt: Identify the part with the grammatical error (or 'No error').
sentence: The performance of the young prodigy (A) / was relative better than (B) / what the critics had initially predicted. (C) / No Error (D)
options: The performance of the young prodigy (A)
what the critics had initially predicted. (C)
explanation: An adverb is needed to modify the comparative adjective, so 'relative better' should be 'relatively better'.
